full_page.content:
1937, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 176 Cont.
Mar. 17 Harry Dettloff - 36 - 1 2/3 yr. stroke - whole right side lame - has wife and little girl 5 ... anxious for their welfare ... Mrs. Nora Fenelon - 72 - broken hip and stroke
Page 177
Mar. 23 Mildred Keppler - 35 - Thanksgiving - had nerveous break-down; seemed quite hopeless - started from a fall and knock on head - came some over two years ago - making promising in own mind if she ever recovered she'd make donation for Poor Souls & Missions. Next day experienced decided improvement and from then on became well. Made offering To-day of $26 as proposed.
23 Baby John Fr. Dubel - infant heir-lip and cleft palet - to have operation as soon as baby is old enought to be out of danger .... Enrolled Today.
Gerald G. Diehl - 20 - T.B. of Kneebone exray ... expects operation after Easter ..
24 th Robert Behrens - 4 - only child fell and cut his arm badly. Drs. fear nerve's gone and hand will be numb .... 29th Reported improved at once after phoning Enrolled To-day - Father Episcopelian.
Hazel Cummings - 65 - cateracts - fears operation otherwise .... James T. Rice - 28 - lower Thanks for prayers last fall - was in St. Jos. Retreat - now home & working ...
Page 178 Mar. 30 Stephen McInerney - in Eloise - 8 months in the Saratogo Hospital - Fr. Anthony's brother. One sister has gone to see him every week
Mrs. Mary Johnson - 65 - Reumatism & diabetes
Marjorie Timmins - 35 - almost - if not totally blind now 12 years - Eye strain
30 Margaret Jansens - 25 - serious stomach - went to "spiritst healer" a number of times now worse than before ..
30 Hugh Mc Donnell - 26 - brain-tuomer - has two operations ... "hope- less" ....
